    Quotients of projective modules by submodules of the socle #

    Setting 3.2 and Construction 3.3 of the manuscript: for a basic algebra Λ with idempotents e_x, e_y and linearly independent s, t ∈ e_x J e_y annihilated on both sides by J = rad Λ, and a Kronecker module T = (V, W; a, b),

    F₁(T) = (Λe_y ⊗ W) / {s ⊗ a(v) + t ⊗ b(v) : v ∈ V}.

    The functor is defined here on all Kronecker modules, of any dimension.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.QuotientData (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type u) [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] :
    Type u

    Setting 3.2. The idempotents e_x, e_y are taken from a complete set of primitive orthogonal idempotents of the basic algebra Λ; this file only uses that s, t ∈ e_x J e_y and Js = Jt = sJ = tJ = 0, so the remaining conditions are recorded as hypotheses where needed.

    • ex : Λ

      The idempotent e_x.

    • ey : Λ

      The idempotent e_y.

    • s : Λ

      The element s ∈ e_x J e_y.

    • t : Λ

      The element t ∈ e_x J e_y.

    • ex_idem : IsIdempotentElem self.ex
    • ey_idem : IsIdempotentElem self.ey
    • s_mem : self.s ∈ Ring.jacobson Λ ∧ self.ex * self.s * self.ey = self.s
    • t_mem : self.t ∈ Ring.jacobson Λ ∧ self.ex * self.t * self.ey = self.t
    • linearIndependent : LinearIndependent k ![self.s, self.t]
    • J_mul_s (j : Λ) : j ∈ Ring.jacobson Λ → j * self.s = 0
    • J_mul_t (j : Λ) : j ∈ Ring.jacobson Λ → j * self.t = 0
    • s_mul_J (j : Λ) : j ∈ Ring.jacobson Λ → self.s * j = 0
    • t_mul_J (j : Λ) : j ∈ Ring.jacobson Λ → self.t * j = 0
